card.name: Start of drug name after linking word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug or medical term that is split into parts, right after a linking word such as on, for, with, of, or and. Seen in headings and interaction sentences.

modes.label: Drug name after preposition
modes.description: First piece of a drug name that follows words like on, with, of, or and in interaction headings.
modes.example: Effects of other Antiepilepsy Drugs (AEDs) on<< Ti>>agabine Hydrochloride: Carb

modes.label: Medical condition term
modes.description: First piece of a long condition word after for or inside a word.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage Modifications for Gemcitabine Injection for<< My>>elosuppression on Day of Treatment

card.plain: It fires on the opening fragment of a long drug or condition name that comes right after a small linking word.
